candidates.name: d1r0A
candidates.idea: 按各列最宽内容分配空间，使所有表头和地名保持单行，优先支持逐行查询与比较。
candidates.label: gold

whys: Every entry stays on one line, and the compact code column leaves room for the longer names. Even row heights and a small right margin make the table easy to scan and well balanced.
All entries remain whole and the even rows support quick lookup. Its compact proportions are balanced, though the longest name and government seat have slightly less breathing room than in C.
All entries remain on one line in a compact, orderly grid. Widths follow the content well, and the small right margin gives the table a little breathing room.

candidates.name: d2r1A
candidates.idea: 以A为基础，从驻地列移出6px给名称列。四列表头和最长内容按测量仍可单行显示；给最长行政区名称增加余量，同时保留驻地列7px的余量，观察两列留白是否更均衡。
candidates.label: gold

whys: Every name and header stays on one line, with consistent row heights and column widths suited to the content. The table uses the full viewport, leaving little spare space at the right edge.
Every entry stays on one line, with a compact code column and comfortable space for longer names. Uniform rows make the table easy to scan, and the columns use the viewport well.
All entries stay on one line, with regular row heights and clear columns. It uses the full viewport width, and the longer names have comfortable space.

candidates.name: contrast
candidates.idea: 名称列的文本空间只有69px，放不下92px的最长名称，会造成不自然的换行并打破行高节奏。
candidates.label: acceptable

whys: The narrower code column gives the government seat enough room to stay on one line. 内蒙古自治区 still breaks, creating one taller row and slowing the scan of province names.
The compact code column suits its contents, but 内蒙古自治区 breaks across two lines, making that row taller and interrupting the otherwise regular scan.
内蒙古自治区 breaks across two lines, making its row taller and interrupting the otherwise regular scan. The code column is compact and the other entries remain clear.
All content is visible, but 内蒙古自治区 and 呼和浩特市 both break across lines. The wide code column consumes space that those names need, and the taller row interrupts the otherwise regular grid.
Both 内蒙古自治区 and 呼和浩特市 wrap in the same row. The wide code column consumes space needed by the names, while the enlarged row disrupts the grid.
Both 内蒙古自治区 and 呼和浩特市 break across lines in the same row. The code column has substantial unused space while the name and seat columns are tight.

analysis.strengths: Every header and entry remains on one line, with consistent row heights and clear alignment. The table fits inside the viewport with visible room to spare.
analysis.faults: The longest province name and government-seat name fit closely against their cell padding, while some available viewport width remains unused.
analysis.spatial_logic: Each column is sized close to the width needed for its longest content. The code and abbreviation columns stay compact, leaving more space for names and government seats.

analysis.strengths: All content remains on one line with the same consistent row rhythm as P. The added width gives the two longer text columns more breathing room.
analysis.faults: The rendered table reaches 360px, leaving no visible margin within the 360px viewport. Its column widths sum to 359px, so it meets the stated column-width limit, but the measured outer width leaves less tolerance at the viewport edge.
analysis.spatial_logic: Q retains P's compact code and abbreviation columns and assigns the remaining width to province names and government seats, using the full stated width allowance.

rounds.insights: Both layouts preserve the essential lookup structure and avoid wrapping. The meaningful tradeoff is between giving the longest names more room and retaining a small margin at the viewport edge; widening the short-code columns would offer little benefit.

synthesis.rationale: P完整显示所有内容，表头和数据均保持单行，便于逐行查找和比较。它在满足内容宽度的同时，为视口右侧留出少量空隙。Q也保持了完整的单行显示，但额外宽度没有带来明显的阅读收益。

general: 先保证表格适合视口，并让表头和有意义的内容单元保持易读。
按内容和阅读任务分配列宽；功能相近的列也不必等宽。
specific: 名称和政府驻地列需要容纳较长地名；代码列可保持紧凑。
单字简称列的宽度主要由表头决定。

synthesis.tradeoffs: P更紧凑并保留右侧余量；Q给名称和政府驻地更多空间，但表格占满360px视口。
synthesis.uncertain: 测量值显示Q的列宽之和为359px、表格总宽为360px；按给定约束及渲染结果，它仍符合宽度要求。
